intro: Cuba has about 10 million people, a number that has fallen as many have emigrated.

chapters.title: People
text: Cubans are of Spanish, African and mixed descent. Spanish is spoken. Afro-Cuban religion Santería is practised alongside Catholicism.
Large Cuban communities live in Miami and elsewhere in the US.

chapters.title: Daily life
text: Health care and education are free, and literacy is near universal, but wages are low and shortages common.

keyTerms.meaning: A religion mixing Yoruba and Catholic beliefs.
